status: Ore Scanner integration plan; exact canonical input and target bindings, not runtime implementation.

scope.primary_use: Calibrate the Ore Scanner through the Spectral Laboratory.
scope.additional_subjects: Ore/mineral families only. Metal inputs are raw plus ingot/refined metal; gem/mineral inputs use one main retained gem/drop. No processing-chain intermediates.
scope.fictional_component_policy: Real chemical elements only, with Ac = Arcane as the sole new fictional component. Native pre-existing references are preserved.

reference_definitions_to_import.name: Arcane
reference_definitions_to_import.basis: The only newly allowed fictional component. Ac denotes Arcane in this pack, not actinium.

diagnostic_policy: Bulk material formulas are defined using real atoms plus Ac. The lab uses selected diagnostic lines, following native Unbound; bound oxygen is not the atmospheric O2 reference. Raw-ore markers exclude ingredients added during refining.
activation_policy: Corronium, Solerium and Tharsite are excluded from the active expansion. Onyx and Earth Core remain excluded for no natural generation.
implementation_requirements: Load the supplied nine real-element definitions and sole new fictional reference Ac. Remove the previous material-specific/Soul placeholder references from this extension.
Use sample_profiles when a raw/ingot/refined sample has a different formula. Use scanner_source and the ore diagnostic_refs for block targets; preserve one ore-family calibration.
Register the accepted item IDs in Spectra sample lookup; defining only tags will not make the machine accept them.
Extend Uses ore-block mappings; lab recognition alone does not extend scanner coverage.
Reuse native references and source flags only where the subject is the same material; preserve existing native recipes and creature-discovery flags.
Do not assume a resource-pack override changes assets/unbound/spectral.json: native code reads it via the classloader. Use a Bertie integration hook or equivalent verified startup extension.
Keep ore aliases/forms in one calibration, not separate sample-discovery chores.
Evaluate scannability against active ore targets so future-only families do not add empty scanner bands.
evidence: Installed resource/feature/loot audit plus current Progression overrides
Current SolarPoolOreFeature and its biome modifier

chemical_formula_conventions.Ac: Arcane, not actinium. The dot-Ac suffix marks arcane modification, not a measured molar loading.
chemical_formula_conventions.alloys: Subscripts are nominal elemental/phase ratios, not a claim of a discrete molecular species.
chemical_formula_conventions.raw_materials: Formulas describe the selected material phase, not every gangue grain or surface oxide.
chemical_formula_conventions.oxygen: Bound O remains in formulas; native atmospheric O2 is not substituted for it.
chemical_formula_conventions.sources: Fictional assignments are authored Bertie definitions grounded in real host materials and available recipe/lore evidence; they are not reported mod canon.
